The Commons are shared resources jointly managed by a community according to a set of rules and social norms that ensure sustainable use and equitable access.

Post-Capitalism reorients production from capitalism’s imperative of capital accumulation towards the satisfaction of societal needs within planetary boundaries.

A regenerative future leverages the commons to restore natural ecosystems and repair the damage capitalist alienation has caused to our social fabric.

The liberatory potential of emerging technologies and horizontal social techniques lies in their ability to empower communal self-governance vis-a-vis centralised authority.

As an experimental playground for post-capitalist systems design, the commons hub explores the liberatory potential of emerging technologies and social techniques that facilitate horizontal communities. 

Our aim is to create a testing ground for the commons that prototypes and applies these innovations, building a regenerative future in the here and now.

By offering decentralized communities a permanent physical home to socialize and connect, we provide a space to grow meaningful relationships and a shared culture.

• Grow our community through events and partnerships

  • Support applied systems design via grants and experiments

  • Strengthen the Hub as economic engine nurturing local Commons

  • Build a living knowledge hub connecting movements and academia

The guest house offers 30 beds distributed in 2 double rooms and 5 dormitories.

The Hub hosts events such as work retreats, conferences, festivals, or weddings. For medium or big events, accommodation is reserved for event participants. 

We also provide an Event Playbook to all event organizers free of charge that supports event planning through templates for time management, content creation and economic calculation.

If you have an idea for an event but only limited capacity to organise it, we got your back. Be it a hackathon, an (un)conference, or a retreat – we have long-standing experience in running events and are happy to help you bring your vision to life. 

Our services range from conceptual planning to practical event preparation, running the event itself and wrap-up. In addition, we have a wide range of professionals we can draw on, be it facilitators, conflict mediators, media teams, yoga teachers or meditation guides.

The Hub accommodates up to 30 people in five dorms and four double rooms. Sheets and towels are provided, the bathrooms are located on the floor.
A cozy welcome area combines living room comfort and old-school bar charm, featuring ample couches, board games, and a vinyl record player for a relaxed, inviting atmosphere.

The entire outside area of around 2000m² can be used by our guests. The front yard is an excellent spot for leisure time and relaxed evenings by the fire. The back garden is where you’ll find our veggies, berries and herbs, and ample space to touch some actual grass.

Our Co-working provides a calm working environment, screens and keyboards, bicycles can be borrowed to explore the surroundings, several workshops contain lots of tools and materials like fabric, paint and wood to become creative, and a piano and other instruments are available for a jam.

90m² fit up to 75 seats facing a 3x6m stage with a massive sound system and a ceiling-mounted projector with a 133’’ drop-down screen. Wireless microphones, two wall-mounted cameras and a tripod-mounted camera feed into a 4-channel video mixer that supports live video streaming and production.

Next to the main stage, the Event Hall, also offering 90m², is a more open space that lends itself to workshops, breakout sessions and as space that can be used for co-working. Typically, events start their mornings in a big circle to map out the day’s schedule on a whiteboard.

As a part of the event hall, a fully equipped plug-and-play podcast studio enables spontaneous and well-planned media production. Guests can easily record their thoughts, presentations, and conversations without being bogged down by technical or spatial challenges.

The 40m² co-working doubles as a dedicated seminar room for smaller events, featuring a 65’’ TV, 20 chairs, a whiteboard, and adaptable and versatile tables and seating arrangements, ideal for workshops or meetings.

The Schneeberg and Rax Plateau provide ample opportunities for hiking, biking, rock climbing, rafting, kayaking, swimming and mushroom foraging.

Hikes range from short walks along the river up to multi-day tours up and across Rax and Schneeberg, all starting from or near the Hub.

Over 2000 climbing routes, many of them multi-pitch, make the area a prime destination for adventurers and rock climbers from Vienna, Bratislava, Budapest and beyond.
Numerous beaches along river Schwarza invite for swimming and sun bathing in walking distance from the Hub

Although its imperial past is long gone, Reichenau an der Rax remains a cultural hub with two musical pavilions and a classical theatre. Its six-week summer festival features two daily plays, along with literature readings, classical music, and other artsy events. Other remnants of the monarchy are various imperial castles, mansions and villas, which account for the noble appearance of the town.
3D printer, laser cutter, wood workshop, soundlab, and other tools are waiting for your creativity
The commons hub garden thrives with raised beds, fruit trees, and a buzzing beehive, creating a vibrant permaculture space. Join us to care for, maintain and expand it, and enjoy its fruits with us!
